name: swallow_japanese_mt_bench
description: A benchmark for evaluating Japanese machine translation systems. It provides Japanese source texts with reference translations and measures translation quality across fluency and adequacy dimensions. Intended to assess MT models' ability to produce accurate and natural Japanese↔other-language translations in a variety of contexts.
reputation: A specialized dataset from Tokyo Tech used in Japanese MT research; useful within niche academic and development settings but not broadly established as a universal MT benchmark.
